ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous central white zone bounded by a high-contrast black margin along the trailing edge and terminal tips. Distinct dark circular spots are visible on the distal-left and mid-right lobes. A dark vertical streak originates from the peduncle base into the central white area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 95 degrees and moderate pixel-depth penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge boundary; significant topographical irregularity and jagged peaks observed at the terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following the trailing edge from the notch to the tips; convex curvature observed along the visible segments of the leading edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters on the white field of the distal-left lobe. Yellowish-brown textured clusters localized at the extreme distal points of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-oriented gray linear disruptions visible on the white surface of the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-brown biological encrustations (barnacle colonization) at the distal-most tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical pigmentation line bisecting the lower central white region.
